variants.label: Nominal motors
variants.description: Reference actuator model and unchanged trained policy.

variants.label: Lower gearing
variants.description: Reduce gear ratio to two thirds of nominal. Less joint torque, more available joint speed.

variants.label: Lower current limit
variants.description: Reduce peak current to 67% of nominal, reducing the available peak motor torque.

variants.label: Current-limit stress test
variants.description: Only 15% of nominal peak current. This deliberately weak motor tests loss of torque authority.

variants.label: Kv ×4 stress test
variants.description: Kv ×4 and Kt ÷4, with resistance and inductance ÷16. A deliberately extreme fixed-copper rewind at the same peak current.

description: Paired Isaac Lab recordings with one trained policy, the same initial physical properties and commands, and a 0.2-second lateral force pulse. These short trials show design sensitivity, not robustness across seeds or hardware efficiency.
